what_happened: the store file is damaged: 3 problems in the search data of email_words

likely_causes.cause: the store's journal file (m.db-wal) was deleted or replaced by another program while `mail sync` had the store open (2026-11-06T11:50:02.000Z)
the computer lost power or crashed, or the disk filled up, while a tool was writing
the disk filled up while a tool was writing
the file was copied, restored or synced while a tool had it open, or it sits in a synced or network folder
a fault of the disk itself

impact: searches may miss results or fail; email_words hold nothing that is not elsewhere, and are rebuilt
reads that do not touch a damaged page work; a write that touches one fails until the store is recovered
external_data_safe: only this computer's copy is damaged: Telegram, MAX, WhatsApp, the mail servers and Google Drive keep their own data, so whatever is lost here can be fetched again by a sync
loss: how many rows were lost is unknown: damage can take rows written since the last deep check that passed (2026-11-01T08:00:00.000Z) without leaving a trace; a sync fetches again what the servers still hold

steps.why: a tool that writes while the store is recovered damages the new file too
copies every readable row into a new file and puts it in place of the store; the damaged file is kept beside it, and it prints the syncs that fetch again what was lost
checks every page again; a check that passes lifts the damage mark
